extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders, and interested parties who wish to submit comments on CFPB notices
extracted.subtask_description: Locate open CFPB notices and submit formal public comments by following the Federal Register notice link for each item. The page lists currently open notices and provides access to the Federal Register submission mechanism and related metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open notices are currently open for public comment
rubrics_metrics.description: The notices listed below are currently open for public comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page lists only those notices that are accepting comments; users should review the listed items to identify opportunities for input.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit a formal comment via the Federal Register notice
rubrics_metrics.description: For each notice, click through to view the Federal Register notice where you can read the full notice and select the “Submit a formal comment” option to contribute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To comment on a particular notice, follow its Federal Register link and use the Federal Register's 'Submit a formal comment' option. The Federal Register notice contains the full text and the official submission mechanism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invited feedback on draft Strategic Plan (FY 2026-2030)
rubrics_metrics.description: We invite your feedback on our draft Strategic Plan for FY 2026-2030.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The CFPB is required to publish a new strategic plan that communicates the Bureau’s mission, strategic goals, and objectives for the next four years – and the Bureau is encouraging the public to provide comments on the draft plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter notices to find relevant items
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page offers a filtering capability (UI control) to narrow the list of open notices to those relevant to the user; use filters to locate specific notices more efficiently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notices include publication metadata and archive access
rubrics_metrics.description: Request for comment or information Published MAR 13, 2026 ... Page last modified Dec. 28, 2022. View older versions of this page at our public archive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each listed notice includes publication date and category information; the page also links to an archive of closed notices and older versions. Users should check dates and archived material for context and prior versions.
